flex.p: EUIX provides 7 native declarative actions to manage state, execute async network calls, run custom JS scripts, and handle UI dialogs:
Sets a target state key (<path>) to a primitive value or evaluated expression (<value>).

pre.class: p-3 bg-slate-900 text-indigo-200 text-xs rounded-lg border border-slate-800 overflow-x-auto max-w-full whitespace-pre-wrap font-mono

flex.p: Performs zero-boilerplate array and numeric state mutations: PUSH, REMOVE, SWAP, INCREMENT, DECREMENT, MOVE_UP, MOVE_DOWN, CLEAR.

pre.class: p-3 bg-slate-900 text-indigo-200 text-xs rounded-lg border border-slate-800 overflow-x-auto max-w-full whitespace-pre-wrap font-mono

<!-- Push new item to array --> <on_click action="MUTATE_STATE" operation="PUSH"> <path>data.todos</path> <value id="{data.next_id}" text="{data.new_todo_input}" completed="false" /> </on_click>
<!-- Remove item matching condition --> <on_click action="MUTATE_STATE" operation="REMOVE"> <path>data.todos</path> <where equals="{item.id}" /> </on_click>

flex.p: Performs asynchronous HTTP requests (GET|POST|PUT|DELETE) and binds response data directly into state.

flex.p: EUIX provides rich declarative lifecycle and state observation hooks directly inside XML:

ul.li: <on_mount>: Executes when element mounts. Commonly used for XHR REST data fetching (<on_mount action="XHR">).
<on_unmount>: Executes automatically when element is unmounted or removed from DOM tree.
<on_state_change>: Watches state key (watch="data.counter") and triggers actions on change.
<on_interval>: Declarative timer hook running every N milliseconds (ms="1000").

pre.class: p-4 bg-slate-950 text-indigo-200 text-xs rounded-xl border border-slate-800 overflow-x-auto max-w-full whitespace-pre-wrap break-words font-mono
pre.code:
<!-- State Watcher Hook --> <on_state_change watch="data.counter" action="SET_STATE"> <path>data.log</path> <value>Counter updated to {data.counter}</value> </on_state_change>
<!-- Recurring Timer Hook --> <on_interval ms="1000" action="SET_STATE"> <path>data.seconds</path> <value>{data.seconds + 1}</value> </on_interval>

flex.p: EUIX Engine declaratively loads external JS libraries (<use_script src="..." />) and CSS stylesheets (<use_style src="..." />) directly inside XML specs. Custom JS code snippets are executed safely in a new Function() sandbox with $el, $data, $engine, and $evt injected:

pre.class: p-4 bg-slate-950 text-indigo-200 text-xs rounded-xl border border-slate-800 overflow-x-auto max-w-full whitespace-pre-wrap break-words font-mono
pre.code:
<use_script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/libs/highlight.js/11.9.0/highlight.min.js" /> <use_style src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/libs/highlight.js/11.9.0/styles/atom-one-dark.min.css" /> <use_script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/canvas-confetti@1.9.2/dist/confetti.browser.min.js" />
<button class="btn-primary"> <on_click action="RUN_SCRIPT"> if (window.confetti) confetti({ particleCount: 150, spread: 90, origin: { y: 0.6 } }); </on_click> 🎉 Celebrate Order </button>

flex.p: EUIX features a component-scoped API client configured via <api_config base_url="..." credentials="..." timeout="..." />:

ul.li: BaseURL Resolution Rules: Action-level base_url overrides component & global defaults.

Local Path Bypass Rule: Local relative paths starting with ./ or ../ (or actions with ignore_base_url="true" / base_url="") automatically bypass external API domain prepending so local XML files load safely.

pre.class: p-4 bg-slate-950 text-indigo-200 text-xs rounded-xl border border-slate-800 overflow-x-auto max-w-full whitespace-pre-wrap break-words font-mono
pre.code:
<api_config base_url="https://api.coingecko.com/api/v3" credentials="include" timeout="5000"> <headers> <header name="Authorization">Bearer token_xyz</header> </headers> </api_config>
<!-- Local file fetch bypasses base_url automatically --> <on_click action="XHR"> <url>./components/DocPortalSection.xml</url> <target>data.code_modal_content</target> </on_click>

flex.p: Stale-While-Revalidate API data refetching triggered declaratively or programmatically:

ul.li: Tagging XHR Requests: Add tag="my_feed" to any XHR action.
Declarative Revalidation: Trigger <on_click action="REVALIDATE_API" tag="my_feed" /> to refetch cached endpoints instantly.
Auto Focus & Network Refetch: Automatic background revalidation when browser window regains focus (window focus) or comes back online (online).

pre.class: p-4 bg-slate-950 text-indigo-200 text-xs rounded-xl border border-slate-800 overflow-x-auto max-w-full whitespace-pre-wrap break-words font-mono
pre.code:
<on_mount action="XHR" tag="pokemon_list"> <url>https://pokeapi.co/api/v2/pokemon?limit=12</url> <target>data.pokemons</target> </on_mount>
<button> <on_click action="REVALIDATE_API" tag="pokemon_list" /> 🔄 Refresh Feed </button>

flex.p: Define reusable CSS utility classes, design tokens, or initial states via XML or external JSON files:

flex.p: EUIX automatically syncs state variables with browser localStorage or sessionStorage declaratively by declaring storage="local|session":

ul.li: Automatic Hydration: On mount, EUIX hydrates state from storage key if present.
Zero-Boilerplate Auto-Sync: Any subsequent state mutation (SET_STATE, MUTATE_STATE) immediately persists the updated state back to Web Storage without writing custom JS code.

pre.class: p-4 bg-slate-950 text-indigo-200 text-xs rounded-xl border border-slate-800 overflow-x-auto max-w-full whitespace-pre-wrap break-words font-mono
pre.code:
<data_model> <!-- Persists in localStorage across page reloads --> <state id="user_settings" storage="local" key="app_v1_settings"> <item theme="dark" notifications="true" /> </state>
<!-- Persists in sessionStorage for current browser tab --> <state id="draft_comment" storage="session" key="active_comment_draft"></state> </data_model>

flex.p: Extend EUIX Engine with custom domain-specific actions registered via JavaScript:

ul.li: Registration API: Call engine.registerAction(actionName, handlerFn) to register custom handlers.
Declarative Invocation: Invoke registered custom actions anywhere in XML specs (<on_click action="MY_CUSTOM_ACTION" />).

pre.class: p-4 bg-slate-950 text-indigo-200 text-xs rounded-xl border border-slate-800 overflow-x-auto max-w-full whitespace-pre-wrap break-words font-mono
pre.code:
<!-- 1. Register Custom Action Handler in JS -->
engine.registerAction("TRACK_ANALYTICS", (actionNode, context) => {
  const eventName = actionNode.getAttribute("event") || "click";
  window.gtag && window.gtag("event", eventName, { path: context._targetEl.id });
});
 
<!-- 2. Invoke Declaratively in XML -->
<button id="buy_now_btn" class="btn-primary">
  <on_click action="TRACK_ANALYTICS" event="purchase_attempt" />
  💳 Complete Purchase
</button>

flex.p: Define reusable named action subroutines and multi-step workflows with parameters, sequential step execution, nested action calls, step data flow propagation, and circular loop protection.

ul.li: Workflow Definitions: Define named workflows with <action_def name="WorkflowName"> and parameter declarations (<param name="..." default="..." required="true" />).
Data Flow & Return Expressions: Sequential steps receive step results automatically via {result} and evaluate optional <return> expressions.

Invocation Syntax: Execute declaratively using <on_click action="EXECUTE_ACTION" name="...">, shorthand <on_click action="WorkflowName">, or programmatically via engine.executeAction("WorkflowName", args).

pre.class: p-4 bg-slate-950 text-indigo-200 text-xs rounded-xl border border-slate-800 overflow-x-auto max-w-full whitespace-pre-wrap break-words font-mono
pre.code:
<actions> <action_def name="SaveUserWorkflow"> <param name="userName" required="true" /> <param name="role" default="User" />
<step action="SET_STATE"> <path>data.user_name</path> <value>{args.userName}</value> </step>
<step action="MUTATE_STATE"> <path>data.logs</path> <operation>UNSHIFT</operation> <value>User {args.userName} added as {args.role}</value> </step>
<return>{data.user_name}</return> </action_def> </actions>
<!-- Declarative Invocation --> <button class="btn-primary"> <on_click action="SaveUserWorkflow"> <arg name="userName">Alice</arg> <arg name="role">Admin</arg> </on_click> Add Admin User </button>
